messages.announcementBody:
Hello,

We opened a feedback board for {{workspace}}. Tell us what to build next, vote on ideas from other customers and follow the progress:

{{url}}

Thank you for your help.
messages.announcementText: Send this to all of your customers to start.
messages.chatBody: We now collect feedback for {{workspace}} in one place. Post an idea or vote for one here: {{url}}
messages.chatText: For a team or community channel.
messages.communityBody: Do you have an idea for {{workspace}}? Post it on our feedback board, or vote for the ideas that you want most: {{url}}
messages.communityText: For a forum, a group or another place where your users meet.
messages.developerBody: Please add the {{workspace}} feedback widget to our app. The snippets are on the Share page of the teammate app, under "Widget embed". The public board is at {{url}}.
messages.developerText: Send this to the person who works on your code.
messages.emailText: Send this to the customers that you want to hear from.
messages.supportBody: Thank you for the suggestion. Please add it to our feedback board, so that other customers can vote for it and you get an update when it ships: {{url}}
messages.supportText: Paste this into a ticket reply or a saved reply.
messages.text: Pick a channel, copy the message and paste it.
